Launch date established by organiser press release of 5 September 2023; source does not specify each individual signature date. No exclusive rate or recurrence inferred.

source_title: G20 Leaders must tax extreme wealth — signatures
grading_note: B-grade: the open letter's signature list on taxextremewealth.com names him (the campaign's own roster), an archived copy shows the entry by 5 September 2023; no statement of his own was found. Upgrade if he signs or says it himself.

design_detail: Explicit campaign platform proposal during the 2018 presidential election to establish an Impôt de Solidarité sur la Fortune (ISF) in Mali targeting mining assets, real estate, and financial bank holdings with a small levy.
quote_original: Je mettrai en place l’ISF qui est l’Impôt de Solidarité sur la Fortune et qui sera basé sur la réalisation minière, immobilière et sur la déclaration des revenus dans les banques avec un petit prélèvement.
quote_en: I will establish the ISF, which is the Solidarity Tax on Wealth, and which will be based on mining and real estate assets and on the declaration of income in banks with a small levy.
source_title: Professeur Clément Mahamadou Dembélé, candidat a la présidentielle de 2018 : « Je veux incarner l’espoir des Maliens »
grading_note: 2018 presidential candidate explicitly proposing an Impôt de Solidarité sur la Fortune (ISF) in an interview outlining his campaign platform.
